card.title: IPhone 6S No Image

claims.statement: iPhone 6S image needs PP5V7_LCM_AVDDH_CONN, PN5V7_LCM_MESON_AVDDN_CONN, PP1V8_LCM_CONN and PP5V7_MESON_AVDDH_CONN (only present when on); these often short and their filters act as fuses.
C4002 shorted is a fairly common cause (no continuity should exist across it).
If all voltages are present and MIPI filters test good, the fault is likely inside the CPU.

procedure: Try a new display; inspect FPC.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
